headline: Executive order signed August 25, 2025, about prosecuting people who burn the American flag.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with federal prosecution connected to burning the American flag. No summary was provided, so the exact rules, the agencies involved, and which laws it relies on are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: People who burn or plan to burn the American flag
who_it_affects.how: The order's title indicates the federal government may focus on prosecuting flag burning, though the specific legal effects are not described.
The title suggests these officials may be directed to act on flag-burning cases, but the details are not given.
